title: Functional group interconversions
caption: A map of the A level reactions linking the main groups, with reagents on the arrows. Following it backwards from a target is how a synthesis is planned.
alt: A flow map: alkene to alcohol (steam, H₃PO₄), halogenoalkane to alcohol (NaOH(aq), heat), primary alcohol to aldehyde to carboxylic acid (acidified dichromate), secondary alcohol to ketone, acid and alcohol to ester.
description: Alkene → alcohol with steam and an H₃PO₄ catalyst.
Halogenoalkane → alcohol with aqueous NaOH, heated.
Primary alcohol → aldehyde (distil) → carboxylic acid (reflux), each with acidified potassium dichromate.
Secondary alcohol → ketone with acidified dichromate.
Carboxylic acid + alcohol → ester with an acid catalyst.
